prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the reference image in a retro-style Indian movie poster or magazine cover featuring an adult woman with shoulder-length wavy black hair, wearing an emerald green silk saree with intricate gold zari motifs. She makes a playful cheerful expression and looks slightly to the side. A single white daisy is tucked behind her ear. Behind her, large tall bold vintage typography reads "ALICE." in dark forest green. The background is textured pale mint with vintage botanical illustrations of pink peonies and cream roses on the bottom left and right. Small serif text at the top reads "Face of a Golden Era." The image has nostalgic grainy film texture and soft lighting. Preserve the retro poster concept and the approved adult face reference; do not use a public-figure likeness.
